newsitem.title: USA: Mego Financial unit to sell $2 bln in loans.
newsitem.headline: Mego Financial unit to sell $2 bln in loans.

text.p: Mego Financial Corp said Wednesday that Greenwich Capital Markets Inc has agreed to buy from its subsidiary, Mego Mortgage, up to $2 billion of loans.
Greenwich Capital also agreed to secure future loan portfolios. The company said the commitment extends for five years, or until $2 billion in loans are purchased.
In addition, Greenwich Capital has agreed to provide Mego Mortgage with $11 million in financing to be secured by participation certificates retained by Mego Mortage in securitization transactions.
In exchange for the commitment, Mego Financial will issue four-year warrants to Greenwich Capital to purchase one million of its common stock at an exercise price of $7.125 per share.
The exercise price was fixed on September 10 when Greenwich Capital agreed in principle to issue the purchase commitment.
